rounds.q: What % of the world's habitable land is used for farming?
rounds.why: Two-thirds of that farmland is grazing land. Only one-third grows crops.
rounds.fun: Two-thirds of farmland is for grazing. The grazers got the bigger slice of pie! 🐑

rounds.q: What % of all farmland goes to livestock, counting pasture and feed crops?
rounds.why: Yet meat, dairy and farmed fish supply just 17% of the world's calories.
rounds.fun: Livestock gets 80% of farmland but gives just 17% of our calories. Pricey snacks! 🥩

rounds.q: What % of all the fresh water people use goes to farming?
rounds.why: Still, about 35 countries irrigate less than 1% of their cropland.
rounds.fun: Farming gulps 72% of the fresh water people use. Thirsty work! 🚜

rounds.q: What % of the food available to shoppers and diners ends up wasted?
rounds.why: Households cause 60% of that waste. Another 13% is lost before it reaches shops.
rounds.src: UNEP, Food Waste Index Report 2024 (2022 data)
rounds.fun: Households cause 60% of food waste. Time to show those leftovers some love! 🥡

rounds.q: What % of the world's people faced hunger in 2024?
rounds.why: That's about 673 million people, down from 8.7% in 2022.
rounds.src: FAO et al., State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2025
rounds.fun: Hunger dipped from 8.7% in 2022 to 8% in 2024. Small steps, but the right way! 🍞
